config_fields.name: entity_type
config_fields.help: Catalog entity type of your listings: SaaSProduct, AmiProduct, ContainerProduct, DataProduct (or Offer).

fields.name: access_key_id
fields.help: AWS access key id of the seller account's IAM principal with aws-marketplace:ListEntities, DescribeEntity and SearchAgreements (e.g. the AWSMarketplaceSellerProductsReadOnly policy plus agreement read access).

fields.name: secret_access_key
fields.help: The matching AWS secret access key; only used to derive the SigV4 signing key.

fields.name: session_token
fields.help: Session token when the keys are temporary STS credentials.

me.note: Verifies the keys by listing one of the seller's own entities (the Catalog API has no identity call).

list_products.note: ListEntities (Catalog AWSMarketplace, OwnershipType SELF) for the configured entity type; `status` is Visibility (Public, Limited, Restricted, Draft). The `status` input is not applied. Cursor-paginated (NextToken).

get_product.note: DescribeEntity (GET /DescribeEntity?catalog=AWSMarketplace&entityId=…): the entity's DetailsDocument (Description, PromotionalResources, Dimensions, SupportInformation, Targeting…) in `raw`; `id` is EntityId@RevisionId. Prices live on Offer entities (describe an offer id for its terms).

list_sales.note: Agreement Service SearchAgreements (PartyType Proposer, AgreementType PurchaseAgreement): the purchase agreements buyers accepted on your offers — agreementId, buyer account, offer, product, status (ACTIVE, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, RENEWED, REPLACED, TERMINATED), epoch-second times. Amounts are not part of agreements (see the seller reports / GetAgreementTerms); `product_id` and `since` inputs are not applied.

list_refunds.note: Agreement Service ListBillingAdjustmentRequests: seller-initiated billing adjustments (refunds) with agreementId (the sale id from list_sales), original invoice, amount, currency, status and epoch-second createdAt; `since` filters createdAfter.

not_offered.create_product: Products are created through StartChangeSet with a CreateProduct change whose DetailsDocument is entity-type specific (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace-catalog/latest/api-reference/API_StartChangeSet.html), and prices belong to a separate Offer entity (UpdatePricingTerms); a name + price + currency cannot form a valid change set.
not_offered.update_price: Prices are pricing terms on an Offer (UpdatePricingTerms change with per-dimension RateCards; https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/work-with-private-offers.html), not a single price on a product.
not_offered.get_sales_stats: Revenue figures come from the seller reports / delivery data feeds delivered to S3 (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/reports-and-data-feed.html), not from a synchronous API.
not_offered.refund: BatchCreateBillingAdjustmentRequest requires originalInvoiceId, currencyCode, adjustmentReasonCode and clientToken for each entry besides agreementId and amount (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/APIReference/API_marketplace-agreements_BatchCreateBillingAdjustmentRequest.html); the vocabulary's refund (sale_id, amount, reason) has no invoice id, so a valid request cannot be built.

adapter.terms: Catalog API (catalog.marketplace.us-east-1.amazonaws.com, REST-JSON) and Agreement Service (agreement-marketplace.us-east-1.amazonaws.com, JSON 1.0 with X-Amz-Target) are both signed with AWS SigV4, signing name aws-marketplace, Region us-east-1 (endpoint and signing metadata from the AWS SDK service models; https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-marketplace.html).

live_check.notes: requires access_key_id, secret_access_key, entity_type; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
